design.sector: Original sector daily series identity; own same-source price-position metrics, explicit unadjusted basis; no guessed name-to-code equivalence across conflicting current codes.
design.index: Explicit stock indexCode only; original daily series and exact same intermediate session dates; each own source stable, same declared sample class.
design.relative: 1/5/10/20-day cumulative returns, percentage-point difference; shorter excess below longer is descriptive, not calibrated decay. Absolute negative return distinct from relative resilience.
design.persistence: 3/5 daily declared full breadth and seal assists independent validity; complete same-source denominator required for breadth, no frozen membership certification. Not a collapse classifier.
design.lookup: Per traversal index/sector maps; binary bounded 60 dates / 240 inspected rows per series, return no evidence on overflow; no claim of large archive performance measurement.
design.limitations: No real market, authorized data source, authoritative exchange calendar, independently frozen member universe, actual collapse/normal divergence labels, native Node/full CI/browser. No new formal gate, threshold, order or notification.
